title: Automation — flows, triggers, roll-ups

items.title: Flow Runs render loop/region iterations as a nested execution tree

requires: a loop flow runnable on demand (e.g. showcase_batch_reminders with a small list input)

steps: run the loop flow with a 3-item input
open the FLOW DESIGNER's Runs panel for that run (not the developer Flow Runs page)

acceptance.clause: the run's steps carry parent/iteration/region tags and the designer Runs panel renders them as a nested tree (per-iteration children under the loop node), not a flat list
acceptance.verify: the run detail API shows parent=loop node, iter=0..2, region=loop-body per body step; the panel screenshot shows the ITERATION-nested rendering
acceptance.evidence: run-detail API read + Runs panel screenshot

source: #3358 §2 — 'the developer Flow Runs page renders steps flat; looking there alone reads as a miss'

history.change: initial import from #3358, encoding its wrong-panel lesson as a trap

items.title: Time-relative flow triggers author first-class and fire per matching record
steps: author a flow start node with timeRelative (offsetDays or withinDays) in the designer
confirm the boot banner binds it; where feasible, stage a record whose date matches and confirm the daily sweep fires

acceptance.clause: the designer renders the first-class timeRelative panel (sweep object / date field / offset days as a numberList editor, not raw JSON)
acceptance.verify: designer panel screenshot shows the dedicated fields

acceptance.clause: the flow binds at boot and a matching record produces a run on the sweep
acceptance.verify: Flows banner counts it bound as time_relative; a staged matching record yields a run row after the sweep

items.title: Filtered roll-up summaries recompute only through their own filter

requires: a parent with several filtered roll-ups in different filter shapes (showcase_expense_report: equality / boolean / operator / unfiltered)
knownGaps: the visual filter-editor half needs a summary field in a WRITABLE package — the showcase ships read-only, so Studio editing is not reachable on stock fixtures (#3358)

steps: flip one child row's filtered dimension over REST (e.g. status approved→rejected)
re-read every roll-up on the parent and independently recompute each from the child rows

acceptance.clause: only the roll-ups whose filter the edit touched move; every value matches an independent recomputation from the child rows
acceptance.verify: before/after parent reads: touched roll-ups change to the recomputed value; unfiltered and untouched-filter roll-ups stay exactly put (the part a naive recompute-everything gets wrong)
acceptance.evidence: before/after value table with the independent recomputation

acceptance.clause: the child-row filter is settable via the visual editor on a writable package
acceptance.verify: edit a summary field's filter in Studio on a writable package and confirm the persisted metadata

blocked.ref: #3358 (editor half needs a writable-package summary field fixture)

source: #3358 §2 (recompute half proven; editor half explicitly left unticked)
